text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the race, just as I was about to enter the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Gaze straight ahead.
Stand with your back straight.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: If you wish to accomplish something, always maintain a majestic demeanor. Carry yourself in a manner worthy of what you aspire to.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I won't be broken by something like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Let's give it some time and come back later.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you have a moment to discuss
the training menu starting tomorrow?
choice_data_list: Let's talk about our next race right away.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, we must produce results
as expeditiously as possible.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please guide and discipline me with that in mind.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to discuss the details of our training
based on that exact point as well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Today's data is already prepared.
Let us begin right away.
